title: About DarGlobal — International Luxury Real Estate Developer
location: London, UK (Headquarters); Dubai, UAE; Riyadh, KSA
description: DarGlobal (LSE: DAR) is the premier international luxury real estate development company, originally founded as the international arm of Dar Al Arkan (Saudi Arabia's premier developer). Listed on the London Stock Exchange, DarGlobal specializes in high-end, design-led second homes, branded luxury residences, and hospitality destinations across prime global locations including the United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah), the United Kingdom (central London), Spain (Marbella, Benahavís), Oman (AIDA cliffside community), Qatar (Simaisma, Doha), and Saudi Arabia (Wadi Safar Riyadh, Jeddah). DarGlobal is renowned for its world-class collaborations with elite brands including The Trump Organization, Automobili Lamborghini, Pagani Automobili, Aston Martin, Elie Saab, Missoni, Mouawad, and Marriott/W Hotels.

title: About Wasalt — Leading Saudi Arabian Real Estate Marketplace
description: Wasalt is a premier digital real estate marketplace in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, backed by Dar Al Arkan. Wasalt offers a comprehensive platform for finding, buying, renting, and investing in residential and commercial properties throughout Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Al Khobar, Mecca, and Medina. All listings on Wasalt are licensed and strictly regulated under Saudi Arabia's Real Estate General Authority (REGA), ensuring transparent legal compliance, advertising licensing numbers, verified ownership, and safe transactions aligned with Saudi Vision 2030.

title: DarGlobal vs Wasalt — Complementary Real Estate Ecosystem
description: How DarGlobal and Wasalt work together: Both entities are part of the prestigious Dar Al Arkan real estate lineage. DarGlobal focuses on ultra-luxury international branded residences and trophy vacation investments across London, Dubai, Spain, Oman, and Qatar. Wasalt provides the definitive national portal for domestic Saudi Arabian real estate, offering thousands of verified residential villas, apartments, masterplans, and commercial properties in key Saudi metropolitan centers like Riyadh and Jeddah. Clients seeking global lifestyle trophies and branded luxury invest through DarGlobal, while clients seeking family homes, rentals, or domestic real estate in the Kingdom search through Wasalt.
